title: Puthu Manithan
desc: Kabali, a fisherman who is both revered and dreaded, falls for Suganthi, a chorus singer, and tries to woo her. When he is about to declare his love, she announces her marriage.

title: Paarthal Pasu
desc: A corrupt police officer is in cahoots with a notorious criminal in running an illegal brothel. Eventually, an honest policewoman joins hands with her lawyer to expose the officer's crimes.

title: Sudhandhiram
desc: Vishwa, a thug and an aspiring boxer, works for Sopraj, a gangster. When Sopraj brutally kills a social worker in front of Vishwa, he decides to turn approver against his boss.

title: Mercury Pookkal
desc: Two people get married due to pressure from their respective families. Eventually, they fall in love with each other, but a new challenge awaits their marriage.

title: Gajendra
desc: Gajendra, an orphan, unabashedly dotes on a girl with a mental disability. However, he faces trouble when his family questions his relationship with the girl, and he refuses to reveal the truth.

title: Kudaikul Mazhai
desc: Parthiban, an auto rickshaw driver, falls in love with a girl, and she loves him too. But later Parthiban learns that the girl is a TV show anchor and was just faking her love for him.
